abstract: A patient with dermoid cyst of the ovary and erythrocytosis is described. Surgical removal of the tumour was followed by a progressive decrease of the red cell mass with remission of the haematological abnormalities. Tumor fluid contained significant erythropoietic stimulating activity. This seems to be the first documented case of erythrocytosis associated with ovarian cyst.
abstract_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫と赤血球増多症を伴う患者を報告する。腫瘍の外科的摘出後、赤血球量は徐々に減少し、血液学的異常は寛解した。腫瘍液には有意な赤血球造血刺激活性が含まれていた。これは卵巣嚢胞に伴う赤血球増多症の初めての文献的報告例と思われる。
